intro: Ten stories from the last day, rewritten in plain British English. Tap any word you don't know.

items.title: Trump may resume Iran strikes after New Year
items.text: President Donald Trump has said he is inclined to resume military strikes against Iran after the New Year if talks fail. Indirect negotiations with Tehran are still going on, according to Fox News. Iranian attacks on oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz have continued, even though the US navy is blockading Iranian ports. Mr Trump said that Iranian vessels trying to cross the blockade would be attacked and sunk. He also encouraged anti-government protesters in Iran to keep demonstrating, and called the Iranian negotiators "professional tap dancers".

gloss.inclined to: likely or willing to do something
gloss.resume: to start again after a pause
gloss.strait: a narrow area of sea between two pieces of land
gloss.blockade: the use of ships to stop people or goods entering or leaving a place
gloss.demonstrate: to take part in a public protest

items.title: COP31 climate summit ends without a deal
items.text: The UN climate summit in Antalya, Türkiye, has closed without an agreement after two weeks of talks. COP31 President Murat Kurum, who is also Türkiye's environment minister, said the main proposed decision had not been adopted. He said that some countries had failed to show the flexibility that was needed. UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres said he was "deeply disappointed" by the outcome. Delegates had hoped to agree a common text on how countries should respond to climate change.

gloss.summit: an important meeting between leaders or governments
gloss.adopt: to formally accept a proposal or decision
gloss.flexibility: a willingness to change your position or compromise
gloss.delegate: a person chosen to represent a country or group at a meeting

items.title: Libya complains to UN over Benghazi ship attacks
items.text: Libya's eastern-based government has asked the United Nations for an international investigation into attacks on Russian and Maltese ships off Benghazi. Earlier on Sunday, it said a Russian ship at the Benghazi naval base was probably hit by drones after an explosion before dawn. Local broadcasters also reported a drone boat attack on a commercial vessel off the port. The government asked whether Ukrainian personnel were in Libya. Neither Russia nor Ukraine had commented. The UN mission in Libya has called for an independent inquiry.

gloss.drone: an aircraft or boat that is flown or steered without a pilot on board
gloss.dawn: the first light of the day, just before sunrise
gloss.personnel: the people who work for an organisation, especially the army

items.title: Liverpool beat Man Utd 4-0 at Anfield
items.text: Liverpool beat Manchester United 4-0 at Anfield on Sunday in Mauricio Pochettino's first game in charge of United. Leny Yoro was sent off after eight minutes for fouling Alexander Isak just outside the box. Dominik Szoboszlai scored from the free kick and Florian Wirtz added a second three minutes later. Rio Ngumoha and substitute Víctor Muñoz scored in the second half. United stayed 19th in the table with eight points, and have now gone nine league games without a win.

gloss.send off: to order a player to leave the pitch for a serious foul
gloss.foul: to break the rules by hitting or pulling an opponent
gloss.free kick: a kick awarded after a foul
gloss.substitute: a player who comes on to replace another

items.title: Alcaraz beats Zverev to win ATP Finals
items.text: Carlos Alcaraz has won his first ATP Finals title, beating world number one Alexander Zverev 6-2, 7-6 in the final in Turin. He saved three set points in the second-set tiebreak before winning it 9-7. The title was his third in a row and extended his winning run to 14 matches. The 23-year-old has seven Grand Slam titles. He returned to the tour after a wrist injury kept him out for more than four months.

gloss.set point: a point which, if won, wins the set for a player
gloss.tiebreak: a short game used to decide a set at 6-6
gloss.winning run: a series of victories one after another
gloss.keep out: to prevent someone from taking part
gloss.Grand Slam: one of the four biggest tennis tournaments of the year

items.title: GTA VI launches to a record start
items.text: Grand Theft Auto VI is now available worldwide, Rockstar Games said. The game came out on 19 November for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S after a series of delays that lasted several years. Yahoo reported a record launch worth $3.8 billion, and called it the biggest game launch of the year. Players have shared viral clips online and discussed secrets they have found in the fictional state of Leonida.

gloss.come out: to be released or become available
gloss.delay: a time when something happens later than planned
gloss.fictional: not real; invented for a story
gloss.launch: the first time a product is sold to the public

items.title: Miley Cyrus marries Maxx Morando
items.text: Miley Cyrus has married the drummer Maxx Morando in a private ceremony in Palm Springs, California. The singer, who is 33, confirmed the news on Instagram on Sunday with a post that said "M + M" and the date, 21 November 2026. Mr Morando is 28. She wore a long-sleeved white silk gown by Saint Laurent, designed by Anthony Vaccarello, and he wore a black tuxedo from the same brand.

gloss.ceremony: a formal event, such as a wedding
gloss.confirm: to say publicly that something is true
gloss.tuxedo: a formal black jacket and trousers worn by men on special occasions
gloss.private: only for invited people, not open to the public
gloss.drummer: a musician who plays the drums

items.title: Quiet sounds may boost the brain's night clean
items.text: Scientists at MIT have found that very short bursts of quiet noise can increase the flow of fluid through the brain during sleep. The study, in Science Translational Medicine, involved 14 healthy volunteers. The 50-millisecond sounds were timed to the peaks of slow brain waves and were quiet enough not to wake anyone. The researchers say the next step is to test whether this improves sleep or clears harmful proteins linked to dementia. The study did not show that more waste was removed.

gloss.burst: a short, sudden period of something
gloss.cerebrospinal fluid: the clear liquid that surrounds the brain and spine
gloss.volunteer: a person who takes part in a study without being forced
gloss.timed to: arranged to happen at a particular moment
gloss.dementia: an illness that affects memory and thinking, mostly in older people
gloss.clear: to remove something that is not wanted

items.title: Musk says Tesla's AI5 chip is for Optimus
items.text: Elon Musk has said that Tesla's new AI5 computer is meant for the company's Optimus robot. In a reply on X on Sunday, he said that cars would keep using the older AI4 computer. He said that AI4 was enough for what he called superhuman driving. He was answering a Tesla owner who had asked when AI5 would reach new cars. Mr Musk did not give a date for any change.

gloss.be meant for: to be intended for a particular use
gloss.superhuman: better than what a normal person can do
gloss.owner: a person who has or possesses something
gloss.allocate: to decide that something will be used for a particular purpose

items.title: South Korea's car trade deficit with China hits record
items.text: South Korea's car trade deficit with China reached a record $4.23 billion between January and October 2026, Yonhap reported. Car imports from China rose 79.2% to $4.39 billion. Over the same period, car exports to China fell 34.9% to $168.77 million. The deficit was $1.73 billion in 2024 and $943 million in 2023. The figures come from the Korea International Trade Association and the trade ministry.

gloss.trade deficit: the amount by which imports are higher than exports
gloss.import: to bring goods into a country to sell them
gloss.export: to send goods to another country to sell them
gloss.record: higher or better than ever before
gloss.figure: a number, especially an official statistic
